name: Channel Cold
body:
Minimum Spell Level: 3rd.

Your energy blast deals cold damage. When it hits, the target takes a -4 penalty to Dexterity (Fortitude negates). The target can use a full-round action on its turn to negate this penalty, and the penalty does not stack with other penalties of the same kind.
